name: vstar-bench-bbox-final
description: A dataset for evaluating bounding-box predictions (object localization/detection) on the VStar benchmark. It provides annotated images with ground-truth bounding boxes to measure how well models predict object locations and extents. The set is intended for assessing detection/localization quality and model calibration for bounding-box outputs.
evaluation_method: mean average precision (mAP) / IoU-based localization metrics
general_score_metric: mean_average_precision (mAP, commonly reported at IoU thresholds such as 0.5)
reputation: A focused, research-oriented dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in niche vision detection experiments; not a widely adopted mainstream benchmark.
